payload.consequence: No wrong recommendation or rework reached the user, because verification was moved ahead of the recommendation; the cost was absorbed by the deviation.
payload.expected: Following the documented step order for an enhancement issue - gather context, recommend and wait for direction, then verify the claim - would yield a sound recommendation.
payload.observed: Step 3's verification guidance covers only bugs (reproduce from the reporter's steps) and PRs (confirm the diff does what it claims), giving no instruction for an enhancement, and it is sequenced after step 2's recommend-and-wait. A literal run would have recommended on the issue's stated premise, which verification then showed to be false.
payload.run_condition: Single enhancement issue triaged against a ~3,600-line Rust crate with 41 tests; the sequencing tension surfaced during initial context gathering, when the full workflow was read ahead of acting; no gate caught it.
payload.workaround_taken: Ran step 3 verification before step 2's recommendation, and extended the bug/PR verification guidance by analogy to an enhancement by empirically probing the issue's stated premise.

payload.consequence: Four extra tool calls before step 1 context gathering could proceed. Both issues were triaged to completion and no deliverable was affected.
payload.expected: The tracker config the skill routes to for reading an issue prescribes 'gh issue view <number> --comments', which should print the issue body, comments, and labels for step 1 context gathering.
payload.observed: Three invocations returned exit status 0 with no stdout, including one run with no pipe and an explicit exit-code echo. Issue content became available only through 'gh issue view <number> --json number,title,state,labels,author,body,comments' redirected to a file.
payload.run_condition: Two-issue triage producing three posted comments and two authority-document amendments; the failure appeared on the first context-gathering command of step 1, was caught immediately by an explicit exit-code check, and the workaround held for all later reads; elapsed time not determinable from the session.
payload.workaround_taken: Routed every subsequent issue and issue-list read through 'gh ... --json' with stdout redirected to a scratchpad file, then read the file.

payload.consequence: Undetermined. domain-modeling was itself the check that would have revealed a nonconformance in those two artifacts, so their conformance to its conventions is unverified rather than verified. payload.expected: Triage step 4 directs running the grilling and domain-modeling skills together to grill an issue into shape, sharpening domain terms and updating CONTEXT.md/ADRs inline as decisions land.
payload.observed: Only grilling was invoked; domain-modeling never loaded. The glossary and ADR edits it governs - the CONTEXT.md Receipt term and an amendment to accepted ADR 0010 - were authored by hand under the grilling skill's execution contract instead.
payload.run_condition: Single-issue triage of one GitHub issue, run to terminal outcome with brief posted and label swapped. The omission surfaced only after that terminal outcome, when the user asked which skills had run; no triage gate caught it.
payload.workaround_taken: The glossary and ADR updates were performed by hand, prompted by the grilling execution contract's requirement for a domain-doc outcome line.

payload.consequence: Correct outcome reached and approved by the maintainer before anything was posted; cost was one added interpretation step at outcome selection plus reading the label doc to decide the coordination label's fate. No rework, no incorrect publication.
payload.expected: Step 5 enumerates the outcomes triage may apply — ready-for-agent, ready-for-human, needs-info, wontfix, needs-triage — and the run needed one of them for a coordinating parent whose four children and own acceptance step had all landed.
payload.observed: None of the five covers closing a completed issue: wontfix means will not be actioned, and this had been actioned. The applied path — completion comment, removal of the orthogonal coordination label, and gh issue close --reason completed — was constructed outside the enumerated set, the label part inferred from docs/agents/triage-labels.md stating that coordination marks an open parent. The skill's rule that every triaged issue carries exactly one state role also had no reading for this close, and none was applied.
payload.run_condition: Single-issue triage of coordinating parent #27 against four closed children, roughly a dozen read-only gh and repository commands across one short attended exchange; the gap surfaced at step 5 after verification had already completed, and was resolved in the recommendation the skill requires before acting.
payload.workaround_taken: Constructed the close-as-completed path, stated the wontfix mismatch explicitly in the recommendation, and confirmed the three concrete actions with the maintainer before executing them.

payload.consequence: The maintainer's blocking checkpoint arrived after the reproduction work rather than before it, so roughly ten tool calls of fixture construction and reproduction were spent before the maintainer had directed that verification should happen. The recommendation delivered was unaffected and no rework followed.
payload.expected: Following the skill's numbered sequence, step 2 delivers the category and state recommendation and then blocks for the maintainer's direction, with step 3's claim verification running after that direction arrives.
payload.observed: The run executed step 3 before step 2: it built a scratch fixture and reproduced the reported defect on four commands plus four control cases, then delivered the recommendation and the verification results together in a single message and blocked for direction at the end of it.
payload.run_condition: One issue triaged end to end across roughly twenty tool calls; the reordering occurred at the run's first codebase contact and no step or gate caught it, surfacing only at this capture.
payload.workaround_taken: The two steps were merged into one message presenting the recommendation and the verification evidence together, with the blocking question asked at its end.
